The optimal solution for your universal testing at high temperature
ZwickRoell's high-temperature testing solutions are based on the proven load frame concept of the AllroundLine. The flexible and modular load frame design in conjunction with an array of high-temperature components enable the configuration of individual testing systems that are optimally matched to the testing requirements of our customers. ZwickRoell offers standard solutions in a temperature range of -80°C up to +1,600°C and customized testing solutions up to +2,000°C.
A testing system for all quasi-static tests (tensile, compression and flexure tests)
Wide temperature range: -80 °C to +1,600 °C with high-temperature furnace and temperature chamber
+200 °C to +2,000 °C with vacuum chamber
Precise measurement and standard-compliant specimen temperature control
Wide selection of contact-type and non-contact extensometers for all applications in the entire temperature range
Corresponding specimen grips for almost all materials (metals, plastics, composites, ...)
Wide range of high-temperature accessories for customized system configurations

Advantages and features of high-temperature testing systems
General
For similar specimens
For different specimens
For large specimens and test variety
General
All ZwickRoell high-temperature testing systems feature: 
Standard-compliant specimen temperature control through a user-independent temperature controller 
Precise force transmission with high-temperature resistant load strings 
Exact measurement of specimen strain with non-contact or contact-type extensometers 
Proven testControl II measurement and control electronics 
testXpert testing software for reliable and traceable test results 
For similar specimens
This testing system for similar specimen geometries and sizes is often used in quality control applications. The fixed specimen temperature measuring device not only enables easy operation, it also creates the foundation for reliable and repeatable test results. 
Table-top testing machine with adjustable working height 
Force range up to 150 kN 
High-temperature furnace with fixed positioning in a temperature range
 of +200°C to +1,250°C 
Specimen temperature measurement with fixed distance between the thermocouples for similar specimen geometries and sizes 
For different specimens
This flexible testing system for different specimen sizes and geometries is often used by research institutes and universities, and allows flexure and compression tests to be performed in addition to tensile tests due to the variable specimen temperature measuring device. 
Table-top testing machine with adjustable working height 
Force range up to 150 kN 
High-temperature furnace with height-adjustable positioning in a temperature range of +200°C to +1,250°C 
Furnace swivel unit enables tests even at room temperature 
Specimen temperature measurement with variable distance between thermocouples for various specimen geometries and sizes 
Variable furnace openings for various mounting options for extensometers and specimen temperature measuring devices 
For large specimens and test variety
This extremely flexible testing system will meet the strict requirements of testing service providers since it covers an expanded force range in addition to the wide array of specimens and tests. 
Floor-standing testing machines with easy and quick adjustment of the working height 
Wide force range up to 250 kN, second load cell for small force ranges can optionally be used 
High-temperature furnace with height-adjustable positioning in a temperature range of +200°C to +1,250°C 
Furnace swivel unit enables tests even at room temperature 
Also available with a lateral work area to prevent the need for modifications and to allow easy switching between room and high-temperature tests 
Specimen temperature measurement with variable distance between thermocouples for various specimen geometries and sizes 
Specimen temperature measurement with variable distance between thermocouples for various specimen geometries and sizes 
We will find the optimal testing solution for your high-temperature application. Please feel free to contact our experts.

High-temperature testing systems for special requirements
ZwickRoell has many years of experience with project planning of customer-specific, high-temperature systems and specializes in complex requirements for high-temperature testing. Our engineers have the expertise necessary to configure the optimal system for your requirements based on our wide selection of system combinations and components.
Testing system for large temperature ranges
Equipped with temperature chamber and furnace, you can perform tests in a temperature range of -80 to +1,200°C.
Testing system for high specimen throughput
High specimen throughput can be achieved by using a furnace carousel with three to six stand-alone furnaces.
Testing system for quick heating and cooling
Testing solutions with induction heating feature quick heating and cooling of metals as well as non-metals.
Testing system for controlled environments and temperatures above 1,500°C
Testing systems with vacuum or inert gas chamber enable the simulation of certain environmental conditions and tests over 1,500°C.
